from preferences import Preferences
from repository import Repository, ScriptedBackend, TransientRead, MissingPreference

cases = [
    ('immediate success', [{'color': 'blue'}], 'success', 1),
    ('recover on second attempt', [TransientRead('busy'), {'color': 'blue'}], 'success', 2),
    ('recover on third attempt', [TransientRead('busy'), TransientRead('busy'), {'color': 'blue'}], 'success', 3),
    ('exhaust retries', [TransientRead('one'), TransientRead('two'), TransientRead('three')], 'TransientRead', 3),
    ('permanent error', [MissingPreference('missing')], 'MissingPreference', 1),
    ('transient then permanent', [TransientRead('busy'), MissingPreference('missing')], 'MissingPreference', 2),
]
for name, outcomes, expected_result, expected_attempts in cases:
    backend = ScriptedBackend(outcomes)
    try:
        Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(' w ')
        actual_result = 'success'
    except Exception as exc:
        actual_result = type(exc).__name__
    passed = actual_result == expected_result and backend.keys == ['w'] * expected_attempts
    print(f'{\"PASS\" if passed else \"FAIL\"}: {name}: expected {expected_result}/{expected_attempts} attempts; got {actual_result}/{len(backend.keys)} attempts; keys={backend.keys"'!r}'"')
PY"
